<h1>Install, lock and update agent skills and instructions.</h1>
<p>Works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode. Instructions become shared sections of AGENTS.md, upstream changes are previewed before you apply them, and the same instructions render for ChatGPT.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/agents-tools/core/blob/master/Documentation/Proposals/AgentInstructions.md">Design</a> · <a href="https://github.com/agents-tools/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md">Contributing</a> · <a href="https://github.com/agents-tools/.github/blob/master/SECURITY.md">Security</a> · <a href="https://github.com/agents-tools/.github/blob/master/SUPPORT.md">Support</a> · <a href="https://github.com/skill-cli">skill-cli</a></p>
</div>

### Use agents

<table>
<tr><td><strong><a href="https://github.com/agents-tools/cli">cli</a></strong><br>The <code>agents</code> command: add skills and instructions from local paths, Git repositories or well-known indexes, write them for each agent, restore them from the lock and watch sources for changes.</td></tr>
</table>
